name: The Sabbath
overview: Scripture reveals that the Sabbath is a divinely instituted day of rest, sanctified by God after His work of creation, as seen in Genesis 2:3 and Exodus 20:11. The command to remember and keep the Sabbath holy emphasizes ceasing from work on this seventh day, not only for individuals but also for their households and servants (Exodus 20:8, 10; Leviticus 23:3). Jesus affirms the continuing validity of the law, including the Sabbath, by declaring that He came to fulfill it rather than abolish it (Matthew 5:17). Thus, the Sabbath serves as a sacred time set apart for rest and worship in obedience to God's established order.
